title: The Man with the Golden Gun
summary: A wealthy real estate developer is found shot in his garden with his shirt off. The team is forced to stay at the mansion with the suspects because of a storm. Since they have no equipment, they need to be creative about how they conduct the investigation.
method: The victim was shot with a shotgun that had a used pistol bullet embedded into the shell. The shirt was removed and replaced with a different one because it would've had evidence of the shot gun blast. The killer framed another suspect by making it look like the victim was shot with a pistol.
motive: The killer found out that the victim was going to change his will to cut off his kids and no longer financially support them.
killer: The killer's son who worked at the company.
notes: The butler from Fresh Prince plays the victim.
